name: Bog Drowner
senses: blindsight 30 ft. (blind beyond this radius); Passive Perception 14

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The drowner makes two Slam attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Bog Slam.

Actions.name: Slam
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. 17 (4d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage.

Actions.name: Bog Slam
Actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 13, one creature within 30 feet. *Failure:* 21 (6d6) Bludgeoning damage.
Actions.clause: is impossible to see until it is close enough to touch you

Bonus Actions.name: Umbral Step
Bonus Actions.text: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the drowner takes the Hide action.

lore: Something drowned in this mire long ago, and the bog grew over it until it wore the mud as a body, wanting only a warm creature to press close and pull under.

generation.userConcept: a mire-thing that is impossible to see until it is close enough to touch you

clauses.text: is impossible to see until it is close enough to touch you

generation.cite: composition after Phase Spider (CR 3) — the rider-heavy bite and the phase-cycle bonus action, scaled into the band
